name: Silver Lake Nature Center Summer Camp
description_short: Weekly nature day camp at Silver Lake Nature Center in Bristol for ages 5 to 14, with hiking, games, crafts, experiments and water games, plus kayaking and fishing once a week. Lunch and snacks are included, and campers 9 to 14 can add one overnight at the center in July.
refund_policy_summary: 50% refund when cancelled more than 7 days before camp; no refund within 7 days or for no-shows; full refund if the center cancels.
notes: Summer 2027: weekly camp Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 4:00, June 14 to August 20; registration opens January 2, 2027 at 10 am. Before care 8:00 to 9:00 is $55 a week, after care 4:00 to 5:30 is $60 a week. The page says lunch and snacks are included for weeks 1 to 9. Optional overnight July 16 to 17 for ages 9 to 14, $85. Week by week dates are not listed, so no sessions are recorded.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page.
